# Food Safety Magazine

> > The leading resource for food safety professionals across the food and beverage supply chain, providing expert guidance, industry news, and professional development.

Food Safety Magazine is published by BNP Media and serves food safety professionals with timely articles, podcasts, eBooks, and expert Q&A tools. The site covers critical topics including sanitation, processing, supply chain management, and regulatory compliance for the food and beverage industry.

## Key Topics

- Food Safety Magazine
- Food Safety Matters Podcast
- Ask FSM (AI Expert Tool)
- Food Safety Professionals
- Food and Beverage Supply Chain
- Industry News and Trends
- eBooks and Resources
- FSM Distinguished Service Award
- FDA Regulations
- Food Safety Best Practices
- Newsletter Subscription
- Foreign Material Detection
- Ready-to-Eat Food Safety
- AFDO (Association of Food and Drug Officials)
- Bio-Terrorism Act of 2002

## Core Resources

- [Food Safety Magazine](https://www.food-safety.com): Homepage for Food Safety Magazine, the leading resource for food safety professionals.
- [Ask FSM](https://www.food-safety.com/ask-fsm): AI-powered tool providing expert answers to food safety professionals' questions.

## Content & Publications

- [Food Safety Matters Podcast](https://www.food-safety.com/articles/topic/288): Food Safety Matters podcast featuring conversations with food safety professionals.
- [eBooks](https://www.food-safety.com/keywords/2933-ebooks): Collection of eBooks on food safety topics including sanitation and processing.

## Recognition & Community

- [FSM Distinguished Service Award](https://www.food-safety.com/fsm-distinguished-service-award): FSM Distinguished Service Award honoring dedicated food safety professionals.
